EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 1
EPISODE LOGLINE: A seamstress is publicly accused of theft at the masquerade, and the masked stranger who defends her is not who he claims.
CONTINUITY NOTES: First episode of the series. Establishes Mara's ruin.

--- SCRIPT START ---

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:03.00) | End: (00:06.00)

Start: (00:06.20) | End: (00:08.40)

Start: (00:08.40) | End: (00:11.00)

**SOUND FX:**

**COUNTESS VALE (Sneering):**
Start: (00:14.50) | End: (00:16.90)

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:17.00) | End: (00:21.00)

**LADY MARA (Whispering, Stunned):**
Start: (00:21.20) | End: (00:23.00)

**CAMERA:**

Start: (00:26.20) | End: (00:30.80)
